```text
--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 3m09s | run 20261112-174937-hunt-783a | 4 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3790

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Slower earlier stats response overwrites the newer one, so the table no longer matches the chosen dates
   where: /stats (GET /api/stats/harvests)
   expected: After changing From to 2026-08-01 and then back to 2026-01-01, the page shows the stats for 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026 (5 harvests)
   saw: {"fields":[{"label":"From","value":"2026-01-01"},{"label":"To","value":"2026-12-31"}],"text":["From","To","2 harvests from 1 Aug 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Best plants","NO. 1","Tomato","600 g · Sungold","View","Tomato"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-174937-hunt-783a/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "newest-response-wins")
2. MEDIUM When loading fails, the summary line still shows the previous range's harvest count next to the error
   where: /stats
   expected: When the stats request fails for a new range, the page shows only an error and no harvest count from an earlier range
   saw: ["From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-174937-hunt-783a/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "no-stale-range-with-error")
3. MEDIUM A stats request that never answers leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen forever, above the old range's table
   where: /stats
   expected: A request that never answers ends in a visible error or a way to retry
   saw: {"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato"],"alerts":["Loading stats…"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-174937-hunt-783a/probes/misc.mjs (expectation "hang-not-stuck-loading")
4. MEDIUM A blank From field quietly becomes 1 Jan of this year, so a valid To date in an earlier year is refused
   where: /stats (GET /api/stats/harvests?to=2025-12-31)
   expected: With From blank and To set to 2025-12-31, the page shows harvests up to that date, or asks for a From date
   saw: {"fields":[{"label":"From","value":""},{"label":"To","value":"2025-12-31"}],"alerts":["5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","The From date must be on or before the To date."],"text":["From","To","This year","5 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026","The From date must be on or before the To date.","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-174937-hunt-783a/probes/blankfrom.mjs (expectation "blank-from-not-silently-this-year")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
```
